name: EPIC 201454571
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 9.6 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201454571 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.561444 (16th-84th percentiles 9.355206-9.88134), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201454571 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.847309 (16th-84th percentiles 0.80619-0.916698), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201454571: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4945.2 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201454571 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4244.257812 (16th-84th percentiles 4172.929688-4333.085938), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.16 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 4,244 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.85 solar masses and 9.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,945 K at its surface.
